name: R2-F2
description: R2-F2 was an R2-series astromech droid that served as part of Red Squadron in the Alliance to Restore the Republic during the Galactic Civil War against the Galactic Empire. It flew with rebel pilot Biggs Darklighter, and the pair were stationed at the moon Yavin 4's Great Temple.

data.name: R2-F2
data.death: During the Battle of Yavin, Yavin system
